'''Jurene''' is a village in [[Cairhien]] that sits on the [[River Erinin]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jurene}}

==Appearance==
Jurene is a small village with wooden houses and thatched rooftops. None of the buildings are more than one story high. A single stone dock caters to the river traffic.

==Activities==
When the ''[[Blue Crane]]'' runs up on a mud flat, [[Egwene al'Vere]], [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] are put ashore and walk to Jurene.{{ref/book|3|37}} While in Jurene, they secure passage to [[Tear]] aboard the ''[[Darter]]''.{{ref/book|3|39}} Later, while in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', Nynaeve attempts to flee to Jurene from [[Moghedien]], thinking that Jurene is a place that Moghedien would not know. Moghedien, with her better knowledge of ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', follows Nynaeve anyway.{{ref/book|5|54}}
